custom_logic_notes: Entry/exit logic is entirely encapsulated in CMS_ES_RSI custom signal filter class. The signal uses a voting system: the filter returns a directional vote weighted by Signal__Weight (1.0), compared against ThresholdOpen (40) to enter and ThresholdClose (20) to exit. The specific RSI crossover/level logic within CMS_ES_RSI is not visible without reading ACMS_ES_RSI.mqh. Expert_EveryTick=false means signals are evaluated once per bar, not every tick. Pending orders with 4-bar expiration are supported by the framework but not explicitly enabled by inputs.
python_conversion_notes: Must reverse-engineer CMS_ES_RSI class from ACMS_ES_RSI.mqh to extract exact RSI(47)/MA(3) crossover or level-crossing logic. The CExpertSignal framework uses a threshold voting system: signal >= ThresholdOpen(40) triggers entry, signal <= -ThresholdClose(-20) triggers close. With Weight=1.0, the filter has full influence. The RSI period of 47 and MA period of 3 are non-standard, suggesting the MA smooths the RSI line and crossovers between RSI and its MA determine direction. Trailing is disabled (TrailingNone). SL/TP are both 0 meaning exits are purely signal-driven. Pending order expiration of 4 bars is set but likely unused since PriceLevel=0 implies market execution.
